cues.en: (serene music)
cues.zh: （平靜音樂）

cues.en: Instructor: Welcome, everyone, to this section on understanding artificial neural networks.
cues.zh: 歡迎大家來到理解人工神經網路的這一節。

cues.en: A large part of this section of the course is going to focus on the theory behind many of the ideas that we're gonna implement with code later on.
cues.zh: 很大部分聚焦理論，之後再用程式實作。

cues.en: So, we basically have the first half of this section which is pure theory lectures and then the second half, where we actually begin implementing these ideas of code.
cues.zh: 基本上前半純理論，後半開始把想法寫成程式。

cues.en: Let's do a quick review of how we're going to gradually build an understanding of artificial neural networks through some discussion about theory.
cues.zh: 快速介紹如何透過理論，逐步理解人工神經網路。

cues.en: So, the first half of this section is really just theory topics.
cues.zh: 前半都是理論主題。

cues.en: We're gonna begin by discussing how we build a simple perceptron model which, essentially, is our copy of a biological neuron through mathematics.
cues.zh: 先討論簡單感知器模型，基本上用數學複製生物神經元。

cues.en: And then, we'll connect that to the larger idea of full neural networks.
cues.zh: 再連到完整神經網路的較大概念。

cues.en: And then, we'll discuss a lot of ideas that fall underneath a neural network.
cues.zh: 接著討論神經網路中的很多概念，

cues.en: Things like activation functions, cost functions, and then, this particular section of the course focuses on just general feed forward networks.
cues.zh: 例如激活函數、成本函數。本節專注一般前饋網路。

cues.en: And in order to understand a feed forward network, you need to understand how it actually learns through backpropagation.
cues.zh: 為理解前饋網路，要知道如何透過反向傳播學習。

cues.en: So, the first half of this section is all these theoretical topics.
cues.zh: 前半就是這些理論。

cues.en: Once we have a solid understanding of these fundamental ideas behind neural networks, we'll be able to move on to the coding topics and we'll begin the coding topics
cues.zh: 扎實理解基本概念後，進入程式，先介紹

cues.en: by talking about the Keras Syntax API, which is the main API now for TensorFlow 2.0 or 2.x.
cues.zh: Keras 語法 API，現在 TensorFlow 2.0 或 2.x 的主要 API。

cues.en: And then, once we understand that Keras Syntax, we'll show you how to build artificial neural networks with Keras for different types of supervised learning tasks, such as regression and classification.
cues.zh: 理解語法後，展示 Keras 建人工神經網路，處理迴歸、分類等不同監督任務。

cues.en: So, we'll first start off with some basic data sets and then, we'll move on to more realistic data sets.
cues.zh: 先用基本資料，再進真實資料。

cues.en: And a big part of these lectures is actually going to be exploratory data analysis as well as feature engineering.
cues.zh: 很大部分是探索分析與特徵工程。

cues.en: Once we have a good understanding of how to perform regression and classification tasks with the Keras API for TensorFlow 2, then we'll move on to having some exercises
cues.zh: 理解 TensorFlow 2 的 Keras API 如何做迴歸、分類後，再做一些

cues.en: for Keras artificial neural networks.
cues.zh: Keras 人工神經網路練習。

cues.en: Then once we do that, we'll visualize our neural networks and their performance through the TensorBoard capabilities.
cues.zh: 接著用 TensorBoard 視覺化網路與效能。

cues.en: Okay, let's get started.
cues.zh: 好，開始。

cues.en: I'll see you at the next lecture.
cues.zh: 下一堂見。
